lines.text: Now in the waist, the deck, in every cabin,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: I flam’d amazement; sometime I’d divide,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And burn in many places; on the topmast,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: The yards, and bowsprit, would I flame distinctly,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Then meet and join. Jove’s lightning, the precursors

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: O’ th’ dreadful thunder-claps, more momentary

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And sight-outrunning were not: the fire and cracks

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Of sulphurous roaring the most mighty Neptune

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Seem to besiege and make his bold waves tremble,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Yea, his dread trident shake.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: My brave spirit!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Who was so firm, so constant, that this coil

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Would not infect his reason?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Not a soul

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: But felt a fever of the mad, and play’d

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Some tricks of desperation. All but mariners

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Plunged in the foaming brine and quit the vessel,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Then all afire with me: the King’s son, Ferdinand,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: With hair up-staring—then like reeds, not hair—

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Was the first man that leapt; cried “Hell is empty,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And all the devils are here.”

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Why, that’s my spirit!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: But was not this nigh shore?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Close by, my master.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: But are they, Ariel, safe?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Not a hair perish’d;

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: On their sustaining garments not a blemish,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: But fresher than before: and, as thou bad’st me,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: In troops I have dispers’d them ’bout the isle.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: The King’s son have I landed by himself,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Whom I left cooling of the air with sighs

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: In an odd angle of the isle, and sitting,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: His arms in this sad knot.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Of the King’s ship

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The mariners, say how thou hast dispos’d,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And all the rest o’ th’ fleet?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Safely in harbour

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Is the King’s ship; in the deep nook, where once

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Thou call’dst me up at midnight to fetch dew

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: From the still-vex’d Bermoothes; there she’s hid:

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: The mariners all under hatches stowed;

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Who, with a charm join’d to their suff’red labour,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: I have left asleep: and for the rest o’ th’ fleet,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Which I dispers’d, they all have met again,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And are upon the Mediterranean flote

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Bound sadly home for Naples,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Supposing that they saw the King’s ship wrack’d,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And his great person perish.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Ariel, thy charge

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Exactly is perform’d; but there’s more work.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: What is the time o’ th’ day?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Past the mid season.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: At least two glasses. The time ’twixt six and now

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Must by us both be spent most preciously.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Is there more toil? Since thou dost give me pains,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Let me remember thee what thou hast promis’d,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Which is not yet perform’d me.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: How now! moody?

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: What is’t thou canst demand?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: My liberty.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Before the time be out? No more!

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: I prithee,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Remember I have done thee worthy service;

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Told thee no lies, made no mistakings, serv’d

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Without or grudge or grumblings: thou didst promise

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: To bate me a full year.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Dost thou forget

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: From what a torment I did free thee?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou dost, and think’st it much to tread the ooze

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Of the salt deep,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To run upon the sharp wind of the north,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To do me business in the veins o’ th’ earth

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: When it is bak’d with frost.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: I do not, sir.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou liest, malignant thing! Hast thou forgot

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The foul witch Sycorax, who with age and envy

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Was grown into a hoop? Hast thou forgot her?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: No, sir.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou hast. Where was she born? Speak; tell me.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Sir, in Argier.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: O, was she so? I must

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Once in a month recount what thou hast been,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Which thou forget’st. This damn’d witch Sycorax,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: For mischiefs manifold, and sorceries terrible

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To enter human hearing, from Argier,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou know’st, was banish’d: for one thing she did

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: They would not take her life. Is not this true?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Ay, sir.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: This blue-ey’d hag was hither brought with child,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And here was left by th’ sailors. Thou, my slave,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As thou report’st thyself, wast then her servant;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And, for thou wast a spirit too delicate

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To act her earthy and abhorr’d commands,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Refusing her grand hests, she did confine thee,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: By help of her more potent ministers,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And in her most unmitigable rage,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Into a cloven pine; within which rift

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Imprison’d, thou didst painfully remain

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: A dozen years; within which space she died,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And left thee there, where thou didst vent thy groans

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As fast as mill-wheels strike. Then was this island—

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Save for the son that she did litter here,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: A freckl’d whelp, hag-born—not honour’d with

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: A human shape.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Yes, Caliban her son.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Dull thing, I say so; he, that Caliban,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Whom now I keep in service. Thou best know’st

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: What torment I did find thee in; thy groans

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Did make wolves howl, and penetrate the breasts

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Of ever-angry bears: it was a torment

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To lay upon the damn’d, which Sycorax

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Could not again undo; it was mine art,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: When I arriv’d and heard thee, that made gape

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The pine, and let thee out.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: I thank thee, master.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: If thou more murmur’st, I will rend an oak

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And peg thee in his knotty entrails till

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou hast howl’d away twelve winters.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Pardon, master:

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: I will be correspondent to command,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And do my spriting gently.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Do so; and after two days

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I will discharge thee.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: That’s my noble master!

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: What shall I do? Say what? What shall I do?

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Go make thyself like a nymph o’ th’ sea. Be subject

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To no sight but thine and mine; invisible

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To every eyeball else. Go, take this shape,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And hither come in ’t. Go, hence with diligence!
[_Exit Ariel._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Awake, dear heart, awake! thou hast slept well;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Awake!
[_Waking._]

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: The strangeness of your story put

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Heaviness in me.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Shake it off. Come on;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: We’ll visit Caliban my slave, who never

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Yields us kind answer.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: ’Tis a villain, sir,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I do not love to look on.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: But as ’tis,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: We cannot miss him: he does make our fire,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Fetch in our wood; and serves in offices

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: That profit us. What ho! slave! Caliban!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou earth, thou! Speak.
[_Within._]

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: There’s wood enough within.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Come forth, I say; there’s other business for thee.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Come, thou tortoise! when?
Re-enter Ariel like a water-nymph.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Fine apparition! My quaint Ariel,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Hark in thine ear.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: My lord, it shall be done.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou poisonous slave, got by the devil himself

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Upon thy wicked dam, come forth!
Enter Caliban.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: As wicked dew as e’er my mother brush’d

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: With raven’s feather from unwholesome fen

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Drop on you both! A south-west blow on ye,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: And blister you all o’er!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: For this, be sure, tonight thou shalt have cramps,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Side-stitches that shall pen thy breath up; urchins

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Shall forth at vast of night that they may work

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: All exercise on thee. Thou shalt be pinch’d

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As thick as honeycomb, each pinch more stinging

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Than bees that made them.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I must eat my dinner.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: This island’s mine, by Sycorax my mother,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Which thou tak’st from me. When thou cam’st first,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Thou strok’st me and made much of me; wouldst give me

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Water with berries in ’t; and teach me how

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: To name the bigger light, and how the less,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: That burn by day and night: and then I lov’d thee,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: And show’d thee all the qualities o’ th’ isle,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: The fresh springs, brine-pits, barren place, and fertile.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Curs’d be I that did so! All the charms

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Of Sycorax, toads, beetles, bats, light on you!

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: For I am all the subjects that you have,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Which first was mine own King; and here you sty me

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: In this hard rock, whiles you do keep from me

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: The rest o’ th’ island.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou most lying slave,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Whom stripes may move, not kindness! I have us’d thee,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Filth as thou art, with human care, and lodg’d thee

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: In mine own cell, till thou didst seek to violate

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The honour of my child.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Oh ho! Oh ho! Would ’t had been done!

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Thou didst prevent me; I had peopled else

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: This isle with Calibans.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Abhorred slave,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Which any print of goodness wilt not take,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Being capable of all ill! I pitied thee,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Took pains to make thee speak, taught thee each hour

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: One thing or other: when thou didst not, savage,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Know thine own meaning, but wouldst gabble like

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: A thing most brutish, I endow’d thy purposes

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: With words that made them known. But thy vile race,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Though thou didst learn, had that in ’t which good natures

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Could not abide to be with; therefore wast thou

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Deservedly confin’d into this rock,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Who hadst deserv’d more than a prison.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: You taught me language, and my profit on ’t

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Is, I know how to curse. The red plague rid you,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: For learning me your language!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Hag-seed, hence!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Fetch us in fuel; and be quick, thou ’rt best,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To answer other business. Shrug’st thou, malice?

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: If thou neglect’st, or dost unwillingly

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: What I command, I’ll rack thee with old cramps,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Fill all thy bones with aches, make thee roar,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: That beasts shall tremble at thy din.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: No, pray thee.
[_Aside._]

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I must obey. His art is of such power,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: It would control my dam’s god, Setebos,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: And make a vassal of him.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: So, slave, hence!
[_Exit Caliban._]
Re-enter Ariel, playing and singing; Ferdinand following.

lines.text: Where should this music be? i’ th’ air or th’ earth?

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: It sounds no more; and sure it waits upon

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Some god o’ th’ island. Sitting on a bank,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Weeping again the King my father’s wrack,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: This music crept by me upon the waters,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Allaying both their fury and my passion

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: With its sweet air: thence I have follow’d it,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND

lines.speaker: FERDINAND

lines.speaker: ARIEL

lines.text: Nothing of him that doth fade

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: But doth suffer a sea-change

lines.speaker: ARIEL

lines.text: Sea-nymphs hourly ring his knell:_

lines.speaker: ARIEL

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: The ditty does remember my drown’d father.

lines.text: This is no mortal business, nor no sound

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: That the earth owes:—I hear it now above me.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: What is’t? a spirit?

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Lord, how it looks about! Believe me, sir,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: It carries a brave form. But ’tis a spirit.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: No, wench; it eats and sleeps and hath such senses

lines.speaker: PROSPERO

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Was in the wrack; and, but he’s something stain’d

lines.text: I ever saw so noble.

lines.text: It goes on, I see,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO

lines.speaker: PROSPERO

lines.speaker: FERDINAND

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: They are both in either’s powers. But this swift business

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I must uneasy make, lest too light winning

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Make the prize light. [_To Ferdinand._] One word more. I charge thee

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: That thou attend me. Thou dost here usurp

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The name thou ow’st not; and hast put thyself

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Upon this island as a spy, to win it

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: From me, the lord on ’t.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: No, as I am a man.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: There’s nothing ill can dwell in such a temple:

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: If the ill spirit have so fair a house,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Good things will strive to dwell with ’t.
[_To Ferdinand._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Follow me.—
[_To Miranda._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Speak not you for him; he’s a traitor.
[_To Ferdinand._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Come;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I’ll manacle thy neck and feet together:

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Sea-water shalt thou drink; thy food shall be

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The fresh-brook mussels, wither’d roots, and husks

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Wherein the acorn cradled. Follow.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: No;

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: I will resist such entertainment till

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Mine enemy has more power.
[_He draws, and is charmed from moving._]

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: O dear father!

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Make not too rash a trial of him, for

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: He’s gentle, and not fearful.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: What! I say,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: My foot my tutor? Put thy sword up, traitor;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Who mak’st a show, but dar’st not strike, thy conscience

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Is so possess’d with guilt: come from thy ward,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: For I can here disarm thee with this stick

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And make thy weapon drop.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Beseech you, father!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Hence! Hang not on my garments.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Sir, have pity;

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I’ll be his surety.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Silence! One word more

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Shall make me chide thee, if not hate thee. What!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: An advocate for an impostor? hush!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou think’st there is no more such shapes as he,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Having seen but him and Caliban: foolish wench!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To th’ most of men this is a Caliban,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And they to him are angels.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: My affections

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Are then most humble; I have no ambition

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: To see a goodlier man.
[_To Ferdinand._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Come on; obey:

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thy nerves are in their infancy again,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And have no vigour in them.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: So they are:

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: My spirits, as in a dream, are all bound up.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: My father’s loss, the weakness which I feel,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: The wrack of all my friends, nor this man’s threats,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: To whom I am subdued, are but light to me,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Might I but through my prison once a day

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Behold this maid: all corners else o’ th’ earth

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Let liberty make use of; space enough

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Have I in such a prison.
[_Aside._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: It works. [_To Ferdinand._] Come on.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou hast done well, fine Ariel! [_To Ferdinand._] Follow me.
[_To Ariel._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Hark what thou else shalt do me.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Be of comfort;

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: My father’s of a better nature, sir,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Than he appears by speech: this is unwonted

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Which now came from him.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou shalt be as free

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As mountain winds; but then exactly do

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: All points of my command.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: To th’ syllable.
[_To Ferdinand._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Come, follow. Speak not for him.
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Alonso, Sebastian, Antonio, Gonzalo, Adrian, Francisco and others.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Beseech you, sir, be merry; you have cause,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: So have we all, of joy; for our escape

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Is much beyond our loss. Our hint of woe

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Is common; every day, some sailor’s wife,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: The masters of some merchant and the merchant,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Have just our theme of woe; but for the miracle,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I mean our preservation, few in millions

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Can speak like us: then wisely, good sir, weigh

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Our sorrow with our comfort.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Prithee, peace.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: He receives comfort like cold porridge.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: The visitor will not give him o’er so.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Look, he’s winding up the watch of his wit; by and by it will strike.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Sir,—

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: One: tell.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: When every grief is entertain’d that’s offer’d,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Comes to the entertainer—

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: A dollar.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Dolour comes to him, indeed: you have spoken truer than you purposed.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: You have taken it wiselier than I meant you should.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Therefore, my lord,—

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Fie, what a spendthrift is he of his tongue!

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: I prithee, spare.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Well, I have done: but yet—

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: He will be talking.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Which, of he or Adrian, for a good wager, first begins to crow?

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: The old cock.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: The cockerel.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Done. The wager?

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: A laughter.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: A match!

lines.speaker: ADRIAN
lines.text: Though this island seem to be desert,—

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Ha, ha, ha!

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: So. You’re paid.

lines.speaker: ADRIAN
lines.text: Uninhabitable, and almost inaccessible,—

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Yet—

lines.speaker: ADRIAN
lines.text: Yet—

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: He could not miss ’t.

lines.speaker: ADRIAN
lines.text: It must needs be of subtle, tender, and delicate temperance.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Temperance was a delicate wench.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Ay, and a subtle; as he most learnedly delivered.

lines.speaker: ADRIAN
lines.text: The air breathes upon us here most sweetly.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: As if it had lungs, and rotten ones.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Or, as ’twere perfum’d by a fen.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Here is everything advantageous to life.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: True; save means to live.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Of that there’s none, or little.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: How lush and lusty the grass looks! how green!

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: The ground indeed is tawny.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: With an eye of green in’t.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: He misses not much.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: No; he doth but mistake the truth totally.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: But the rarity of it is,—which is indeed almost beyond credit,—

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: As many vouch’d rarities are.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: That our garments, being, as they were, drenched in the sea, hold

lines.text: stained with salt water.

lines.text: If but one of his pockets could speak, would it not say he lies?

lines.text: Ay, or very falsely pocket up his report.

lines.text: Methinks our garments are now as fresh as when we put them on first in

lines.text: of Tunis.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: ’Twas a sweet marriage, and we prosper well in our return.

lines.text: Tunis was never graced before with such a paragon to their Queen.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Not since widow Dido’s time.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Widow! a pox o’ that! How came that widow in? Widow Dido!

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: What if he had said, widower Aeneas too?

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Good Lord, how you take it!

lines.speaker: ADRIAN
lines.text: Widow Dido said you? You make me study of that; she was of Carthage,

lines.speaker: ADRIAN
lines.text: not of Tunis.

lines.text: This Tunis, sir, was Carthage.

lines.speaker: ADRIAN
lines.text: Carthage?

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I assure you, Carthage.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: His word is more than the miraculous harp.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: He hath rais’d the wall, and houses too.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: What impossible matter will he make easy next?

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: I think he will carry this island home in his pocket, and give it his

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: son for an apple.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: And, sowing the kernels of it in the sea, bring forth more islands.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Ay.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Why, in good time.
[_To Alonso._]

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Sir, we were talking that our garments seem now as fresh

lines.text: as when we were at Tunis at the marriage of your daughter, who is now

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Queen.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: And the rarest that e’er came there.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Bate, I beseech you, widow Dido.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: O! widow Dido; ay, widow Dido.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Is not, sir, my doublet as fresh as the first day I wore it? I mean, in

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: a sort.

lines.text: That sort was well fish’d for.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: When I wore it at your daughter’s marriage?

lines.text: You cram these words into mine ears against

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: The stomach of my sense. Would I had never

lines.text: Married my daughter there! for, coming thence,

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: My son is lost; and, in my rate, she too,

lines.text: Who is so far from Italy removed,

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: I ne’er again shall see her. O thou mine heir

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Of Naples and of Milan, what strange fish

lines.text: Hath made his meal on thee?

lines.text: Sir, he may live:

lines.speaker: FRANCISCO
lines.text: I saw him beat the surges under him,

lines.speaker: FRANCISCO
lines.text: And ride upon their backs. He trod the water,

lines.speaker: FRANCISCO
lines.text: Whose enmity he flung aside, and breasted

lines.text: The surge most swoln that met him. His bold head

lines.text: ’Bove the contentious waves he kept, and oared

lines.speaker: FRANCISCO
lines.text: Himself with his good arms in lusty stroke

lines.text: To th’ shore, that o’er his wave-worn basis bowed,

lines.speaker: FRANCISCO
lines.text: As stooping to relieve him. I not doubt

lines.text: He came alive to land.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: No, no, he’s gone.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Sir, you may thank yourself for this great loss,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: That would not bless our Europe with your daughter,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: But rather lose her to an African;

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Where she, at least, is banish’d from your eye,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Who hath cause to wet the grief on ’t.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Prithee, peace.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: You were kneel’d to, and importun’d otherwise

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: By all of us; and the fair soul herself

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Weigh’d between loathness and obedience at

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Which end o’ th’ beam should bow. We have lost your son,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: I fear, for ever: Milan and Naples have

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: More widows in them of this business’ making,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Than we bring men to comfort them.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: The fault’s your own.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: So is the dear’st o’ th’ loss.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: My lord Sebastian,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: The truth you speak doth lack some gentleness

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: And time to speak it in. You rub the sore,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: When you should bring the plaster.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: And most chirurgeonly.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: It is foul weather in us all, good sir,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: When you are cloudy.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Foul weather?

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Very foul.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Had I plantation of this isle, my lord,—

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: He’d sow ’t with nettle-seed.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Or docks, or mallows.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: And were the King on’t, what would I do?

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: ’Scape being drunk for want of wine.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I’ th’ commonwealth I would by contraries

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Execute all things; for no kind of traffic

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Would I admit; no name of magistrate;

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Letters should not be known; riches, poverty,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: And use of service, none; contract, succession,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Bourn, bound of land, tilth, vineyard, none;

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: No use of metal, corn, or wine, or oil;

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: No occupation; all men idle, all;

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: And women too, but innocent and pure;

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: No sovereignty,—

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Yet he would be King on’t.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: The latter end of his commonwealth forgets the beginning.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: All things in common nature should produce

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Without sweat or endeavour; treason, felony,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Sword, pike, knife, gun, or need of any engine,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Would I not have; but nature should bring forth,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Of it own kind, all foison, all abundance,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: To feed my innocent people.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: No marrying ’mong his subjects?

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: None, man; all idle; whores and knaves.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I would with such perfection govern, sir,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: T’ excel the Golden Age.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Save his Majesty!

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Long live Gonzalo!

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: And,—do you mark me, sir?

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Prithee, no more: thou dost talk nothing to me.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I do well believe your highness; and did it to minister occasion to

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: these gentlemen, who are of such sensible and nimble lungs that they

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: always use to laugh at nothing.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: ’Twas you we laughed at.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Who in this kind of merry fooling am nothing to you. So you may

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: continue, and laugh at nothing still.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: What a blow was there given!

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: An it had not fallen flat-long.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: You are gentlemen of brave mettle. You would lift the moon out of her

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: sphere, if she would continue in it five weeks without changing.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: We would so, and then go a-bat-fowling.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Nay, good my lord, be not angry.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: No, I warrant you; I will not adventure my discretion so weakly. Will

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: you laugh me asleep, for I am very heavy?

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Go sleep, and hear us.
[_All sleep but Alonso, Sebastian and Antonio._]

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: What, all so soon asleep! I wish mine eyes

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Would, with themselves, shut up my thoughts: I find

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: They are inclin’d to do so.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Please you, sir,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Do not omit the heavy offer of it:

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: It seldom visits sorrow; when it doth,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: It is a comforter.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: We two, my lord,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Will guard your person while you take your rest,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: And watch your safety.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Thank you. Wondrous heavy!

lines.text: What a strange drowsiness possesses them!

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: It is the quality o’ th’ climate.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Why

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Doth it not then our eyelids sink? I find not

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Myself dispos’d to sleep.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Nor I. My spirits are nimble.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: They fell together all, as by consent;

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: They dropp’d, as by a thunder-stroke. What might,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Worthy Sebastian? O, what might?—No more.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: And yet methinks I see it in thy face,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: What thou shouldst be. Th’ occasion speaks thee; and

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: My strong imagination sees a crown

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Dropping upon thy head.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: What, art thou waking?

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Do you not hear me speak?

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: I do; and surely

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: It is a sleepy language, and thou speak’st

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Out of thy sleep. What is it thou didst say?

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: This is a strange repose, to be asleep

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: With eyes wide open; standing, speaking, moving,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: And yet so fast asleep.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Noble Sebastian,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Thou let’st thy fortune sleep—die rather; wink’st

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Whiles thou art waking.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Thou dost snore distinctly:

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: There’s meaning in thy snores.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: I am more serious than my custom; you

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Must be so too, if heed me; which to do

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Trebles thee o’er.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Well, I am standing water.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: I’ll teach you how to flow.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Do so: to ebb,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Hereditary sloth instructs me.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: O,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: If you but knew how you the purpose cherish

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Whiles thus you mock it! how, in stripping it,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: You more invest it! Ebbing men indeed,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Most often, do so near the bottom run

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: By their own fear or sloth.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Prithee, say on:

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
