lines.text: Point to rich ends. This my mean task

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Would be as heavy to me as odious, but

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: The mistress which I serve quickens what’s dead,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: And makes my labours pleasures: O, she is

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Ten times more gentle than her father’s crabbed,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: And he’s compos’d of harshness. I must remove

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Some thousands of these logs, and pile them up,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Upon a sore injunction: my sweet mistress

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Weeps when she sees me work, and says such baseness

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Had never like executor. I forget:

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: But these sweet thoughts do even refresh my labours,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Most busy, least when I do it.
Enter Miranda and Prospero behind.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Alas now, pray you,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Work not so hard: I would the lightning had

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Burnt up those logs that you are enjoin’d to pile!

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Pray, set it down and rest you. When this burns,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: ’Twill weep for having wearied you. My father

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Is hard at study; pray, now, rest yourself:

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: He’s safe for these three hours.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: O most dear mistress,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: The sun will set, before I shall discharge

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: What I must strive to do.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: If you’ll sit down,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I’ll bear your logs the while. Pray give me that;

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I’ll carry it to the pile.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: No, precious creature;

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: I had rather crack my sinews, break my back,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Than you should such dishonour undergo,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: While I sit lazy by.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: It would become me

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: As well as it does you: and I should do it

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: With much more ease; for my good will is to it,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: And yours it is against.
[_Aside._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Poor worm! thou art infected.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: This visitation shows it.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: You look wearily.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: No, noble mistress; ’tis fresh morning with me

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: When you are by at night. I do beseech you—

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Chiefly that I might set it in my prayers—

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: What is your name?

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Miranda—O my father!

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I have broke your hest to say so.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Admir’d Miranda!

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Indeed, the top of admiration; worth

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: What’s dearest to the world! Full many a lady

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: I have ey’d with best regard, and many a time

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Th’ harmony of their tongues hath into bondage

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Brought my too diligent ear: for several virtues

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Have I lik’d several women; never any

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: With so full soul but some defect in her

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Did quarrel with the noblest grace she ow’d,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: And put it to the foil: but you, O you,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: So perfect and so peerless, are created

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Of every creature’s best.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I do not know

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: One of my sex; no woman’s face remember,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Save, from my glass, mine own; nor have I seen

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: More that I may call men than you, good friend,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: And my dear father: how features are abroad,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I am skilless of; but, by my modesty,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: The jewel in my dower, I would not wish

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Any companion in the world but you;

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Nor can imagination form a shape,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Besides yourself, to like of. But I prattle

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Something too wildly, and my father’s precepts

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I therein do forget.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: I am, in my condition,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: A prince, Miranda; I do think, a King;

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: I would not so!—and would no more endure

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: This wooden slavery than to suffer

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: The flesh-fly blow my mouth. Hear my soul speak:

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: The very instant that I saw you, did

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: My heart fly to your service; there resides,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: To make me slave to it; and for your sake

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Am I this patient log-man.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Do you love me?

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: O heaven, O earth, bear witness to this sound,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: And crown what I profess with kind event,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: If I speak true; if hollowly, invert

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: What best is boded me to mischief! I,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Beyond all limit of what else i’ the world,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Do love, prize, honour you.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I am a fool

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: To weep at what I am glad of.
[_Aside._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Fair encounter

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Of two most rare affections! Heavens rain grace

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: On that which breeds between ’em!

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Wherefore weep you?

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: At mine unworthiness, that dare not offer

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: What I desire to give; and much less take

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: What I shall die to want. But this is trifling;

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: And all the more it seeks to hide itself,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: The bigger bulk it shows. Hence, bashful cunning!

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: And prompt me, plain and holy innocence!

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: I am your wife if you will marry me;

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: If not, I’ll die your maid: to be your fellow

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: You may deny me; but I’ll be your servant,

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Whether you will or no.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: My mistress, dearest;

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: And I thus humble ever.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: My husband, then?

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Ay, with a heart as willing

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: As bondage e’er of freedom: here’s my hand.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: And mine, with my heart in ’t: and now farewell

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Till half an hour hence.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: A thousand thousand!
[_Exeunt Ferdinand and Miranda severally._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: So glad of this as they, I cannot be,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Who are surpris’d withal; but my rejoicing

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: At nothing can be more. I’ll to my book;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: For yet, ere supper time, must I perform

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Much business appertaining.
[_Exit._]
Enter Caliban with a bottle, Stephano and Trinculo.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Tell not me:—when the butt is out we will drink water; not a drop

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: before: therefore bear up, and board ’em. Servant-monster, drink to me.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: Servant-monster! The folly of this island! They say there’s but five

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: upon this isle; we are three of them; if th’ other two be brained like

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: us, the state totters.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Drink, servant-monster, when I bid thee: thy eyes are almost set in thy

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: head.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: Where should they be set else? He were a brave monster indeed, if they

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: were set in his tail.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: My man-monster hath drown’d his tongue in sack: for my part, the sea

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: cannot drown me; I swam, ere I could recover the shore, five-and-thirty

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: leagues, off and on, by this light. Thou shalt be my lieutenant,

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: monster, or my standard.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: Your lieutenant, if you list; he’s no standard.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: We’ll not run, Monsieur monster.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: Nor go neither. But you’ll lie like dogs, and yet say nothing neither.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Moon-calf, speak once in thy life, if thou beest a good moon-calf.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: How does thy honour? Let me lick thy shoe. I’ll not serve him, he is

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: not valiant.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: Thou liest, most ignorant monster: I am in case to justle a constable.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: Why, thou deboshed fish thou, was there ever man a coward that hath

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: drunk so much sack as I today? Wilt thou tell a monstrous lie, being

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: but half a fish and half a monster?

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Lo, how he mocks me! wilt thou let him, my lord?

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: “Lord” quoth he! That a monster should be such a natural!

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Lo, lo again! bite him to death, I prithee.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Trinculo, keep a good tongue in your head: if you prove a mutineer, the

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: next tree! The poor monster’s my subject, and he shall not suffer

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: indignity.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I thank my noble lord. Wilt thou be pleas’d to hearken once again to

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: the suit I made to thee?

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Marry. will I. Kneel and repeat it. I will stand, and so shall

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Trinculo.
Enter Ariel, invisible.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: As I told thee before, I am subject to a tyrant, a sorcerer, that by

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: his cunning hath cheated me of the island.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Thou liest.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Thou liest, thou jesting monkey, thou;

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I would my valiant master would destroy thee;

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I do not lie.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Trinculo, if you trouble him any more in his tale, by this hand, I will

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: supplant some of your teeth.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: Why, I said nothing.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Mum, then, and no more. Proceed.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I say, by sorcery he got this isle;

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: From me he got it. If thy greatness will,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Revenge it on him,—for I know thou dar’st;

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: But this thing dare not,—

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: That’s most certain.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Thou shalt be lord of it and I’ll serve thee.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: How now shall this be compassed? Canst thou bring me to the party?

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Yea, yea, my lord: I’ll yield him thee asleep,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Where thou mayst knock a nail into his head.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Thou liest. Thou canst not.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: What a pied ninny’s this! Thou scurvy patch!

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I do beseech thy greatness, give him blows,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: And take his bottle from him: when that’s gone

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: He shall drink nought but brine; for I’ll not show him

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Where the quick freshes are.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Trinculo, run into no further danger: interrupt the monster one word

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: further, and by this hand, I’ll turn my mercy out o’ doors, and make a

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: stock-fish of thee.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: Why, what did I? I did nothing. I’ll go farther off.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Didst thou not say he lied?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Thou liest.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Do I so? Take thou that.
[_Strikes Trinculo._]

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: As you like this, give me the lie another time.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: I did not give the lie. Out o’ your wits and hearing too? A pox o’ your

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: bottle! this can sack and drinking do. A murrain on your monster, and

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: the devil take your fingers!

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Ha, ha, ha!

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Now, forward with your tale.—Prithee stand further off.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Beat him enough: after a little time,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I’ll beat him too.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Stand farther.—Come, proceed.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Why, as I told thee, ’tis a custom with him

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I’ th’ afternoon to sleep: there thou mayst brain him,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Having first seiz’d his books; or with a log

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Batter his skull, or paunch him with a stake,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Or cut his wezand with thy knife. Remember

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: First to possess his books; for without them

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: He’s but a sot, as I am, nor hath not

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: One spirit to command: they all do hate him

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: As rootedly as I. Burn but his books.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: He has brave utensils,—for so he calls them,—

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Which, when he has a house, he’ll deck withal.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: And that most deeply to consider is

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: The beauty of his daughter; he himself

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Calls her a nonpareil: I never saw a woman

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: But only Sycorax my dam and she;

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: But she as far surpasseth Sycorax

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: As great’st does least.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Is it so brave a lass?

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Ay, lord, she will become thy bed, I warrant,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: And bring thee forth brave brood.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Monster, I will kill this man. His daughter and I will be king and

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: queen,—save our graces!—and Trinculo and thyself shall be viceroys.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Dost thou like the plot, Trinculo?

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: Excellent.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Give me thy hand: I am sorry I beat thee; but while thou liv’st, keep a

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: good tongue in thy head.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Within this half hour will he be asleep.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Wilt thou destroy him then?

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Ay, on mine honour.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: This will I tell my master.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Thou mak’st me merry. I am full of pleasure.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Let us be jocund: will you troll the catch

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: You taught me but while-ere?

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: At thy request, monster, I will do reason, any reason. Come on,

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Trinculo, let us sing.
[_Sings._]

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: _Flout ’em and cout ’em,

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: and scout ’em and flout ’em:

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Thought is free._

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: That’s not the tune.
[_Ariel plays the tune on a tabor and pipe._]

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: What is this same?

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: This is the tune of our catch, played by the picture of Nobody.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: If thou beest a man, show thyself in thy likeness: if thou beest a

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: devil, take ’t as thou list.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: O, forgive me my sins!

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: He that dies pays all debts: I defy thee. Mercy upon us!

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Art thou afeard?

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: No, monster, not I.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Be not afeard. The isle is full of noises,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Sounds, and sweet airs, that give delight, and hurt not.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Sometimes a thousand twangling instruments

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Will hum about mine ears; and sometimes voices,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: That, if I then had wak’d after long sleep,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Will make me sleep again: and then, in dreaming,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: The clouds methought would open and show riches

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Ready to drop upon me; that, when I wak’d,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I cried to dream again.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: This will prove a brave kingdom to me, where I shall have my music for

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: nothing.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: When Prospero is destroyed.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: That shall be by and by: I remember the story.

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: The sound is going away. Let’s follow it, and after do our work.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Lead, monster: we’ll follow. I would I could see this taborer! he lays

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: it on. Wilt come?

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: I’ll follow, Stephano.
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Alonso, Sebastian, Antonio, Gonzalo, Adrian, Francisco, &c.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: By ’r lakin, I can go no further, sir;

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: My old bones ache: here’s a maze trod, indeed,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Through forth-rights and meanders! By your patience,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I needs must rest me.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Old lord, I cannot blame thee,

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Who am myself attach’d with weariness

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: To th’ dulling of my spirits: sit down, and rest.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Even here I will put off my hope, and keep it

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: No longer for my flatterer: he is drown’d

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Whom thus we stray to find; and the sea mocks

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Our frustrate search on land. Well, let him go.
[_Aside to Sebastian._]

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: I am right glad that he’s

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: so out of hope.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Do not, for one repulse, forgo the purpose

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: That you resolv’d to effect.
[_Aside to Antonio._]

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: The next advantage

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Will we take throughly.
[_Aside to Sebastian._]

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Let it be tonight;

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: For, now they are oppress’d with travel, they

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Will not, nor cannot, use such vigilance

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: As when they are fresh.
[_Aside to Antonio._]

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: I say, tonight: no more.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Solemn and strange music: and Prospero above, invisible. Enter several

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: strange Shapes, bringing in a banquet: they dance about it with gentle

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: actions of salutation; and inviting the King &c., to eat, they depart.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: What harmony is this? My good friends, hark!

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Marvellous sweet music!

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Give us kind keepers, heavens! What were these?

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: A living drollery. Now I will believe

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: That there are unicorns; that in Arabia

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: There is one tree, the phoenix’ throne; one phoenix

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: At this hour reigning there.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: I’ll believe both;

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: And what does else want credit, come to me,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: And I’ll be sworn ’tis true: travellers ne’er did lie,

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Though fools at home condemn them.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: If in Naples

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I should report this now, would they believe me?

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: If I should say, I saw such islanders,—

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: For, certes, these are people of the island,—

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Who, though, they are of monstrous shape, yet, note,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Their manners are more gentle, kind, than of

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Our human generation you shall find

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Many, nay, almost any.
[_Aside._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Honest lord,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou hast said well; for some of you there present

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Are worse than devils.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: I cannot too much muse

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Such shapes, such gesture, and such sound, expressing—

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Although they want the use of tongue—a kind

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Of excellent dumb discourse.
[_Aside._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Praise in departing.

lines.speaker: FRANCISCO
lines.text: They vanish’d strangely.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: No matter, since

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: They have left their viands behind; for we have stomachs.—

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Will’t please you taste of what is here?

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Not I.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Faith, sir, you need not fear. When we were boys,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Who would believe that there were mountaineers

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Dewlapp’d like bulls, whose throats had hanging at ’em

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Wallets of flesh? Or that there were such men

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Whose heads stood in their breasts? which now we find

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Each putter-out of five for one will bring us

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Good warrant of.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: I will stand to, and feed,

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Although my last, no matter, since I feel

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: The best is past. Brother, my lord the duke,

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Stand to, and do as we.
Thunder and lightning. Enter Ariel like a Harpy; claps his wings upon the table; and, with a quaint device, the banquet vanishes.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: You are three men of sin, whom Destiny,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: That hath to instrument this lower world

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And what is in’t,—the never-surfeited sea

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Hath caused to belch up you; and on this island

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Where man doth not inhabit; you ’mongst men

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Being most unfit to live. I have made you mad;

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And even with such-like valour men hang and drown

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Their proper selves.
[_Seeing Alonso, Sebastian &c., draw their swords._]

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: You fools! I and my fellows

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Are ministers of Fate: the elements

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Of whom your swords are temper’d may as well

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Wound the loud winds, or with bemock’d-at stabs

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Kill the still-closing waters, as diminish

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: One dowle that’s in my plume. My fellow-ministers

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Are like invulnerable. If you could hurt,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Your swords are now too massy for your strengths,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And will not be uplifted. But, remember—

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: For that’s my business to you,—that you three

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: From Milan did supplant good Prospero;

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Expos’d unto the sea, which hath requit it,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Him and his innocent child: for which foul deed

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: The powers, delaying, not forgetting, have

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Incens’d the seas and shores, yea, all the creatures,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Against your peace. Thee of thy son, Alonso,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: They have bereft; and do pronounce, by me

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Ling’ring perdition,—worse than any death

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Can be at once,—shall step by step attend

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: You and your ways; whose wraths to guard you from—

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Which here, in this most desolate isle, else falls

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Upon your heads,—is nothing but heart-sorrow,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And a clear life ensuing.
[_He vanishes in thunder: then, to soft music, enter the Shapes again, and dance, with mocks and mows, and carry out the table._]
[_Aside._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Bravely the figure of this Harpy hast thou

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Perform’d, my Ariel; a grace it had, devouring.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Of my instruction hast thou nothing bated

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: In what thou hadst to say: so, with good life

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And observation strange, my meaner ministers

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Their several kinds have done. My high charms work,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And these mine enemies are all knit up

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: In their distractions; they now are in my power;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And in these fits I leave them, while I visit

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Young Ferdinand,—whom they suppose is drown’d,—

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And his and mine lov’d darling.
[_Exit above._]

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I’ the name of something holy, sir, why stand you

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: In this strange stare?

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: O, it is monstrous! monstrous!

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Methought the billows spoke, and told me of it;

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: The winds did sing it to me; and the thunder,

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: That deep and dreadful organ-pipe, pronounc’d

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: The name of Prosper: it did bass my trespass.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Therefore my son i’ th’ ooze is bedded; and

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: I’ll seek him deeper than e’er plummet sounded,

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: And with him there lie mudded.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: But one fiend at a time,

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: I’ll fight their legions o’er.

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: I’ll be thy second.
[_Exeunt Sebastian and Antonio._]

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: All three of them are desperate: their great guilt,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Like poison given to work a great time after,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Now ’gins to bite the spirits. I do beseech you

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: That are of suppler joints, follow them swiftly

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: And hinder them from what this ecstasy

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: May now provoke them to.

lines.speaker: ADRIAN
lines.text: Follow, I pray you.
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Prospero, Ferdinand and Miranda.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: If I have too austerely punish’d you,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Your compensation makes amends: for I

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Have given you here a third of mine own life,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Or that for which I live; who once again

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I tender to thy hand: all thy vexations

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Were but my trials of thy love, and thou

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Hast strangely stood the test: here, afore Heaven,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I ratify this my rich gift. O Ferdinand,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Do not smile at me that I boast her off,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: For thou shalt find she will outstrip all praise,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And make it halt behind her.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: I do believe it

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Against an oracle.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Then, as my gift and thine own acquisition

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Worthily purchas’d, take my daughter: but

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: If thou dost break her virgin knot before

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: All sanctimonious ceremonies may

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: With full and holy rite be minister’d,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: No sweet aspersion shall the heavens let fall

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To make this contract grow; but barren hate,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Sour-ey’d disdain, and discord shall bestrew

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The union of your bed with weeds so loathly

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: That you shall hate it both: therefore take heed,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As Hymen’s lamps shall light you.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: As I hope

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: For quiet days, fair issue, and long life,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: With such love as ’tis now, the murkiest den,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: The most opportune place, the strong’st suggestion

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Our worser genius can, shall never melt

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Mine honour into lust, to take away

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: The edge of that day’s celebration,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: When I shall think, or Phoebus’ steeds are founder’d,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Or Night kept chain’d below.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Fairly spoke:

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Sit, then, and talk with her, she is thine own.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: What, Ariel! my industrious servant, Ariel!
Enter Ariel.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: What would my potent master? here I am.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thou and thy meaner fellows your last service

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Did worthily perform; and I must use you

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: In such another trick. Go bring the rabble,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: O’er whom I give thee power, here to this place.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Incite them to quick motion; for I must

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Bestow upon the eyes of this young couple

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Some vanity of mine art: it is my promise,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And they expect it from me.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Presently?

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Ay, with a twink.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Before you can say “Come” and “Go,”

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: And breathe twice, and cry “so, so,”

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Each one, tripping on his toe,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Will be here with mop and mow.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Do you love me, master? no?

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Dearly, my delicate Ariel. Do not approach

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Till thou dost hear me call.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Well, I conceive.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Look thou be true; do not give dalliance

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Too much the rein: the strongest oaths are straw

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To th’ fire i’ the blood: be more abstemious,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Or else good night your vow!

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: I warrant you, sir;

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: The white cold virgin snow upon my heart

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Abates the ardour of my liver.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Well.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Now come, my Ariel! bring a corollary,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Rather than want a spirit: appear, and pertly.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: No tongue! all eyes! be silent.
[_Soft music._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: A Masque. Enter Iris.

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Ceres, most bounteous lady, thy rich leas

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Of wheat, rye, barley, vetches, oats, and peas;

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Thy turfy mountains, where live nibbling sheep,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: And flat meads thatch’d with stover, them to keep;

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Thy banks with pioned and twilled brims,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Which spongy April at thy hest betrims,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: To make cold nymphs chaste crowns; and thy broom groves,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Whose shadow the dismissed bachelor loves,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Being lass-lorn; thy pole-clipt vineyard;

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: And thy sea-marge, sterile and rocky-hard,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Where thou thyself dost air: the Queen o’ th’ sky,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Whose wat’ry arch and messenger am I,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Bids thee leave these; and with her sovereign grace,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Here on this grass-plot, in this very place,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: To come and sport; her peacocks fly amain:

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Approach, rich Ceres, her to entertain.
Enter Ceres.

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Hail, many-colour’d messenger, that ne’er

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Dost disobey the wife of Jupiter;

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Who with thy saffron wings upon my flowers

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Diffusest honey drops, refreshing showers;

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: And with each end of thy blue bow dost crown

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: My bosky acres and my unshrubb’d down,

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Rich scarf to my proud earth; why hath thy queen

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Summon’d me hither to this short-grass’d green?

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: A contract of true love to celebrate,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: And some donation freely to estate

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: On the blest lovers.

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Tell me, heavenly bow,

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: If Venus or her son, as thou dost know,

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Do now attend the queen? Since they did plot

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: The means that dusky Dis my daughter got,

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Her and her blind boy’s scandal’d company

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: I have forsworn.

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Of her society

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Be not afraid. I met her deity

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Cutting the clouds towards Paphos, and her son

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Dove-drawn with her. Here thought they to have done

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Some wanton charm upon this man and maid,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Whose vows are, that no bed-right shall be paid

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Till Hymen’s torch be lighted; but in vain.

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Mars’s hot minion is return’d again;

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Her waspish-headed son has broke his arrows,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Swears he will shoot no more, but play with sparrows,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: And be a boy right out.

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Highest queen of State,

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Great Juno comes; I know her by her gait.
Enter Juno.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: How does my bounteous sister? Go with me

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: To bless this twain, that they may prosperous be,

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: And honour’d in their issue.
[_They sing._]

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: _Honour, riches, marriage-blessing,

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Long continuance, and increasing,

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Hourly joys be still upon you!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Juno sings her blessings on you._

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: _Earth’s increase, foison plenty,

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Barns and garners never empty;

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Vines with clust’ring bunches growing;

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Plants with goodly burden bowing;

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Spring come to you at the farthest

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: In the very end of harvest!

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Scarcity and want shall shun you;

lines.speaker: CERES
lines.text: Ceres’ blessing so is on you._

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: This is a most majestic vision, and

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Harmonious charmingly. May I be bold

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: To think these spirits?

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Spirits, which by mine art

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I have from their confines call’d to enact

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: My present fancies.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Let me live here ever.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: So rare a wonder’d father and a wise,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Makes this place Paradise.
[_Juno and Ceres whisper, and send Iris on employment._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Sweet now, silence!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Juno and Ceres whisper seriously,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: There’s something else to do: hush, and be mute,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Or else our spell is marr’d.

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: You nymphs, call’d Naiads, of the windring brooks,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: With your sedg’d crowns and ever-harmless looks,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Leave your crisp channels, and on this green land

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Answer your summons; Juno does command.

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Come, temperate nymphs, and help to celebrate

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: A contract of true love. Be not too late.
Enter certain Nymphs.

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: You sun-burn’d sicklemen, of August weary,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Come hither from the furrow, and be merry:

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: Make holiday: your rye-straw hats put on,

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: And these fresh nymphs encounter every one

lines.speaker: IRIS
lines.text: In country footing.

Enter certain Reapers, properly habited: they join with the Nymphs in a graceful dance; towards the end whereof Prospero starts suddenly, and speaks; after which, to a strange, hollow, and confused noise, they heavily vanish.
[_Aside._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I had forgot that foul conspiracy

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Of the beast Caliban and his confederates

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Against my life: the minute of their plot

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Is almost come. [_To the Spirits._] Well done! avoid; no

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: more!

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: This is strange: your father’s in some passion

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: That works him strongly.

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Never till this day

lines.speaker: MIRANDA
lines.text: Saw I him touch’d with anger so distemper’d.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: You do look, my son, in a mov’d sort,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As if you were dismay’d: be cheerful, sir:

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Our revels now are ended. These our actors,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As I foretold you, were all spirits and

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Are melted into air, into thin air:

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And, like the baseless fabric of this vision,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The cloud-capp’d towers, the gorgeous palaces,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The solemn temples, the great globe itself,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Yea, all which it inherit, shall dissolve,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And, like this insubstantial pageant faded,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Leave not a rack behind. We are such stuff

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As dreams are made on, and our little life

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Is rounded with a sleep. Sir, I am vex’d:

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Bear with my weakness; my old brain is troubled.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Be not disturb’d with my infirmity.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: If you be pleas’d, retire into my cell

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And there repose: a turn or two I’ll walk,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To still my beating mind.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND, MIRANDA
lines.text: We wish your peace.
[_Exeunt._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Come, with a thought. I thank thee, Ariel. Come!
Enter Ariel.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Thy thoughts I cleave to. What’s thy pleasure?

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Spirit,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: We must prepare to meet with Caliban.

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Ay, my commander. When I presented Ceres,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: I thought to have told thee of it; but I fear’d

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Lest I might anger thee.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Say again, where didst thou leave these varlets?

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: I told you, sir, they were red-hot with drinking;

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: So full of valour that they smote the air

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: For breathing in their faces; beat the ground

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: For kissing of their feet; yet always bending

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Towards their project. Then I beat my tabor;

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: At which, like unback’d colts, they prick’d their ears,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Advanc’d their eyelids, lifted up their noses

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: As they smelt music: so I charm’d their ears,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: That calf-like they my lowing follow’d through

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Tooth’d briers, sharp furzes, pricking goss, and thorns,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Which enter’d their frail shins: at last I left them

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: I’ th’ filthy-mantled pool beyond your cell,

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: There dancing up to th’ chins, that the foul lake

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: O’erstunk their feet.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: This was well done, my bird.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Thy shape invisible retain thou still:

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The trumpery in my house, go bring it hither

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: But by immortal Providence she’s mine.

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: I chose her when I could not ask my father

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: For his advice, nor thought I had one. She

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Is daughter to this famous Duke of Milan,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Of whom so often I have heard renown,

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: But never saw before; of whom I have

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: Receiv’d a second life; and second father

lines.speaker: FERDINAND
lines.text: This lady makes him to me.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: I am hers:

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: But, O, how oddly will it sound that I

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Must ask my child forgiveness!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: There, sir, stop:

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Let us not burden our remembrances with

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: A heaviness that’s gone.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I have inly wept,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Or should have spoke ere this. Look down, you gods,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: And on this couple drop a blessed crown;

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: For it is you that have chalk’d forth the way

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Which brought us hither.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: I say, Amen, Gonzalo!

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Was Milan thrust from Milan, that his issue

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Should become Kings of Naples? O, rejoice

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Beyond a common joy, and set it down

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: With gold on lasting pillars: in one voyage

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Did Claribel her husband find at Tunis,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: And Ferdinand, her brother, found a wife

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Where he himself was lost; Prospero his dukedom

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: In a poor isle; and all of us ourselves,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: When no man was his own.
[_To Ferdinand and Miranda._]

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Give me your hands:

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Let grief and sorrow still embrace his heart

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: That doth not wish you joy!

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Be it so. Amen!
Re-enter Ariel with the Master and Boatswain amazedly following.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: O look, sir, look, sir! Here are more of us.

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: I prophesied, if a gallows were on land,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: This fellow could not drown. Now, blasphemy,

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: That swear’st grace o’erboard, not an oath on shore?

lines.speaker: GONZALO
lines.text: Hast thou no mouth by land? What is the news?

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: The best news is that we have safely found

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: Our King and company. The next, our ship,—

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: Which but three glasses since, we gave out split,

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: Is tight and yare, and bravely rigg’d as when

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: We first put out to sea.
[_Aside to Prospero._]

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Sir, all this service

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Have I done since I went.
[_Aside to Ariel._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: My tricksy spirit!

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: These are not natural events; they strengthen

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: From strange to stranger. Say, how came you hither?

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: If I did think, sir, I were well awake,

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: I’d strive to tell you. We were dead of sleep,

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: And,—how, we know not,—all clapp’d under hatches,

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: Where, but even now, with strange and several noises

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: Of roaring, shrieking, howling, jingling chains,

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: And mo diversity of sounds, all horrible,

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: We were awak’d; straightway, at liberty:

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: Where we, in all her trim, freshly beheld

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: Our royal, good, and gallant ship; our master

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: Cap’ring to eye her. On a trice, so please you,

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: Even in a dream, were we divided from them,

lines.speaker: BOATSWAIN
lines.text: And were brought moping hither.
[_Aside to Prospero._]

lines.speaker: ARIEL
lines.text: Was’t well done?
[_Aside to Ariel._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Bravely, my diligence. Thou shalt be free.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: This is as strange a maze as e’er men trod;

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: And there is in this business more than nature

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Was ever conduct of: some oracle

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Must rectify our knowledge.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Sir, my liege,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Do not infest your mind with beating on

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: The strangeness of this business. At pick’d leisure,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Which shall be shortly, single I’ll resolve you,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Which to you shall seem probable, of every

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: These happen’d accidents; till when, be cheerful

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And think of each thing well. [_Aside to Ariel._] Come hither, spirit;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Set Caliban and his companions free;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Untie the spell.
[_Exit Ariel._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: How fares my gracious sir?

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: There are yet missing of your company

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Some few odd lads that you remember not.
Re-enter Ariel driving in Caliban, Stephano and Trinculo in their stolen apparel.

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: Every man shift for all the rest, and let no man take care for himself,

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: for all is but fortune.—Coragio! bully-monster, coragio!

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: If these be true spies which I wear in my head, here’s a goodly sight.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: O Setebos, these be brave spirits indeed.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: How fine my master is! I am afraid

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: He will chastise me.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Ha, ha!

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: What things are these, my lord Antonio?

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Will money buy them?

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Very like; one of them

lines.speaker: ANTONIO
lines.text: Is a plain fish, and, no doubt, marketable.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Mark but the badges of these men, my lords,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Then say if they be true. This mis-shapen knave,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: His mother was a witch; and one so strong

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: That could control the moon, make flows and ebbs,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And deal in her command without her power.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: These three have robb’d me; and this demi-devil,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: For he’s a bastard one, had plotted with them

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To take my life. Two of these fellows you

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Must know and own; this thing of darkness I

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Acknowledge mine.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: I shall be pinch’d to death.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Is not this Stephano, my drunken butler?

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: He is drunk now: where had he wine?

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: And Trinculo is reeling-ripe: where should they

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Find this grand liquor that hath gilded ’em?

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: How cam’st thou in this pickle?

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: I have been in such a pickle since I saw you last that, I fear me, will

lines.speaker: TRINCULO
lines.text: never out of my bones. I shall not fear fly-blowing.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Why, how now, Stephano!

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: O! touch me not. I am not Stephano, but a cramp.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: You’d be King o’ the isle, sirrah?

lines.speaker: STEPHANO
lines.text: I should have been a sore one, then.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: This is as strange a thing as e’er I look’d on.
[_Pointing to Caliban._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: He is as disproportioned in his manners

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As in his shape. Go, sirrah, to my cell;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Take with you your companions. As you look

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To have my pardon, trim it handsomely.

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Ay, that I will; and I’ll be wise hereafter,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: And seek for grace. What a thrice-double ass

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: Was I, to take this drunkard for a god,

lines.speaker: CALIBAN
lines.text: And worship this dull fool!

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Go to; away!

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Hence, and bestow your luggage where you found it.

lines.speaker: SEBASTIAN
lines.text: Or stole it, rather.
[_Exeunt Caliban, Stephano and Trinculo._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Sir, I invite your Highness and your train

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: To my poor cell, where you shall take your rest

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: For this one night; which, part of it, I’ll waste

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: With such discourse as, I not doubt, shall make it

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Go quick away: the story of my life

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And the particular accidents gone by

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Since I came to this isle: and in the morn

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I’ll bring you to your ship, and so to Naples,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Where I have hope to see the nuptial

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Of these our dear-belov’d solemnized;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And thence retire me to my Milan, where

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Every third thought shall be my grave.

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: I long

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: To hear the story of your life, which must

lines.speaker: ALONSO
lines.text: Take the ear strangely.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I’ll deliver all;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And promise you calm seas, auspicious gales,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And sail so expeditious that shall catch

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Your royal fleet far off. [_Aside to Ariel._] My Ariel,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: chick,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: That is thy charge: then to the elements

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Be free, and fare thou well! Please you, draw near.
[_Exeunt._]

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: EPILOGUE

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Now my charms are all o’erthrown,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And what strength I have’s mine own,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Which is most faint. Now ’tis true,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: I must be here confin’d by you,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Or sent to Naples. Let me not,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Since I have my dukedom got,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And pardon’d the deceiver, dwell

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: In this bare island by your spell,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: But release me from my bands

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: With the help of your good hands.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Gentle breath of yours my sails

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Must fill, or else my project fails,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Which was to please. Now I want

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Spirits to enforce, art to enchant;

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: And my ending is despair,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Unless I be reliev’d by prayer,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Which pierces so that it assaults

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Mercy itself, and frees all faults.

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: As you from crimes would pardon’d be,

lines.speaker: PROSPERO
lines.text: Let your indulgence set me free.
[_Exit._]
